shared_observation.corr_01_status: RESOLVED — both paths now receive z = [28.4, -10.9] px as raw observation

ekf_result.innovation_note: y = z - H·x; H·x = 0 by construction so y = z exactly

ops_excluded: scalar additions in all matrix operations
loop indexing, pivot comparisons in inversion

inputs_v03.note: V0.3: same raw observation as EKF; A operator computes residual from locus values

after_A.note: e0 = z_observed - z_predicted = innovation; CORR-01 resolved

abr_result.display_correction_note: negative u is corrective: R(e₁) = ρ·(Σ_succ - Σ_pred) = ρ·(0 - g[e₀]); opposes upstream residual
ops_excluded: base term g[e] in B and R accumulation (structural additions)
rho computation per locus (multiply + divide, not per edge)
scalar component work within each 2D operator step

interpretation.ekf: Near-full single-step correction. Optimal estimator: applies full K·y in one frame.
interpretation.abr: Conservative per-frame correction. ρ-weighted: applies 1/60 of residual per frame. Converges smoothly over multiple steps; avoids single-frame overcorrection. No matrix inversion or covariance update required.

comparison_pixel_space.corr_01_status: RESOLVED — direct pixel-space comparison now valid; both paths received z = [28.4, -10.9] px

comparison.ekf_output_space: pixel space via H·K·y (V0.3), state space (meters) for posterior

findings_returned_to_origin.original_description: EKF and ABR paths did not receive the same observational input. EKF received raw z = [28.4, -10.9] px; ABR received pre-computed residual = 1.0 px. Direct numerical comparison was not valid.
findings_returned_to_origin.resolution: AbrInputs now carries z_observed and z_predicted (same raw observation as EKF). A operator computes residual = z_observed - z_predicted from declared locus values, producing the same quantity as EKF innovation y = z - H·x. EkfResult gains pixel_correction = H·K·y for pixel-space output comparison.
